parts.answer: SB-AX17-2026-09 requires a temporary hepatic monitoring enhancement. Baseline hepatic laboratory values are required, with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21. If ALT/AST is >3x ULN, a medical review is required. If Bilirubin is >2x ULN, an urgent review is required. For a mild isolated change below trigger, a repeat test is required. This bulletin does not change the approved German renal starting dose of 25 mg once daily for moderate renal impairment.
